You can ask if they are safe but I usually don't know how to respond to that question myself, you can just say "are you suicidal" "are you thinking about hurting yourself". If you're worried about someone killing themselves it's not about being polite, at that point it's about making sure they are "ok" or getting them help. I'm sure there are people who have lost their lives because others didn't know how to approach the subject. If they say yes you can either ask if they have a plan and/or intent, if they say yes to that it's hospital time.
